name: Ekegården - Koarp
description: Ekegården to Koarp. Check current trail, access and service notices before departure.
waterSources: Dricksvatten Skråmered: Official water refill at a farm in Skråmered; text thanks the property owner for the service. No season stated.

Dricksvatten vid Koarp: Official Koarp water record: fresh water in a tap beside the shelter, available 15 Apr-15 Oct, possibly longer if no strong frost risk. Lägerplats Koarp record currently notes tap problems and temporary 20 litre water container.
notes: Official page/API reports 13 km / 13000 m, while GPX desc says Total: 12.8 km and computed geometry is about 12.770 km.

GPX/API geo_json is 457 points from Ekegården to Koarp and stitches exactly to S8. API line.geometry is 554 points, 13.546 km, starts about 291.7 m east/north of the official GPX start, and ends about 19.8 m from official endpoint.
Naturkartan title and length are current, but the route shape is reverse Koarp-to-Ekegården and ends about 293 m from the official GPX start.
OSM tags match name/distance/from/to, and nearest points align with endpoints, but route-geometry lane found member ordering broken/gap-heavy.
Länsstyrelsen says Hallandsleden goes through Musikedalen, while the rules lane's registry geometry check found the reserve about 329 m from the S9 GPX near km 11.56 and not intersecting.
Official water record says seasonal water is available 15 Apr-15 Oct. Lägerplats Koarp current text says the tap has problems and a 20 litre water container has been placed at the shelter meanwhile.

facilities.name: Lägerplats Ekegården
facilities.description: Shared S8/S9 endpoint shelter in a glade. Official text says shelter for 4-5 adults, fireplace and dry toilet. OSM corroborates shelter, toilet, firepit and waste basket.

routeProximity.notes: Official coordinate; OSM subfacilities are closer to the GPX start within about 15-23 m.

facilities.name: Dricksvatten Skråmered
facilities.description: Official water refill at a farm in Skråmered; text thanks the property owner for the service. No season stated.

facilities.name: Sliprännor i Smedjeån
facilities.description: Ancient grooved sharpening stone in Smedjeån about 100 m downstream from the bridge. Official text says the small bridge out to the stone is currently out of function.

facilities.name: Istidslandskap
facilities.description: Official POI for glacial landscape with eskers and dead-ice hollows.

facilities.name: Stenbro över Klippebäcken
facilities.description: Small old stone bridge over Klippebäcken before the beech forest approach to Koarp.

facilities.name: Lägerplats Koarp
facilities.description: S9 endpoint camp and Hallandsleden/Skåneleden junction. Official text says two shelters, fireplace, dry toilet, drinking water and parking. Water is seasonal 15 Apr-15 Oct; official place text currently says the water tap has problems and a 20 litre water container is placed at the shelter meanwhile.

routeProximity.notes: OSM campsite/shelter/water/toilet/firepit subnodes are about 23-35 m from the GPX endpoint.
